external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provides a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us. They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP. Each partner has a static key we issued when they onboarded
external_entities.notes: The source describes three partners but does not name them individually.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Analysts query the warehouse directly. They are on the warehouse network and authenticate with SSO

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler running in the landing network that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery without validating row contents beyond the schema.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network. The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket into which the insurance partners push daily claim-record extracts and from which the Airflow scheduler reads files.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP. The extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth.
data_stores.notes: The source states uncertainty about encryption: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted". It also says the bucket is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source states uncertainty about encryption: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest". It also says the database is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse into which the Spark transform job loads normalized claim records and which analysts query directly.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery. ... Analysts query the warehouse directly.
data_stores.notes: The grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.
